tools.name: SixNG
tools.line: Pulls models, textures, audio, text and map data out of your own GTA VI install into glTF, PNG and WAV.
tools.works: Author lists textures, models, map placements, collision, audio and text as working; file names are recovered from inside resources because the archive index is encrypted and not read.
tools.limits: Some compressed textures use fitted tables, so a few blocks can be slightly off. Materials are partial.

tools.name: gta6x
tools.line: A read-only Python toolkit that lists and exports textures, audio, video and metadata from a GTA VI package, with nothing to install.
tools.works: Author lists texture, audio, video, metadata and shader inspection as supported.
tools.limits: Model and world export needs the SixNG backend.

tools.name: AWC from RPF9 Extractor
tools.line: Extracts the music streams out of RPF9 files.

tools.name: ttpf-kit
tools.line: Reads and rewrites .ttpf containers and makes patches that refuse to apply to the wrong file.
tools.works: Parse, replace, diff, apply and verify, with tests.
tools.limits: Tested on synthetic files only, so compatibility with real .ttpf files is not established. Compressed (BCPack) textures can only be swapped whole.

tested.synthetic: 32 tests on synthetic files, including malformed input and failed writes (Linux, Wine and native Windows).
tested.windows: Windows 10 (build 19045, Python 3.10.11): all 32 tests passed on 24 Nov 2026, synthetic files only.

tools.name: ttpf-spec
tools.line: A written spec of the .ttpf texture container with a status on every field and a small reference reader.
tools.works: Per-field status, open questions listed, reader passes its self-test.
tools.limits: Built from community notes and never compared with a genuine file here. Some fields are listed as unresolved.

tested.synthetic: The reference reader passes a self-test on synthetic files. The Kaitai definition has not been compiled.

tools.name: TTPF Viewer
tools.platforms: Windows; macOS and Linux from source
tools.line: Browses thousands of textures in .ttpf files at once and saves them as PNG or DDS, with cube maps and texture arrays.
tools.works: Author lists BC1 to BC7, HDR and uncompressed formats, with layout read from the file header.
tools.limits: Cannot decode textures stored only as BCPack.

tools.name: rage9-re
tools.line: Reads script.rpf and anim.rpf, writes script data as XML or JSON and animation clips as glTF.
tools.works: Author lists script containers (PSIN) parsing for all 1,012 files in script.rpf, and animation channels decoding to .glb clips. The repository contains no game data; you supply your own files.
tools.limits: Only a few named bones are mapped in the glTF export, so the full skeleton is not rebuilt. About 1% of animation steps jump by more than 20 degrees. Most field names in script data are unresolved hashes. No releases; you build it yourself.

tested.synthetic: Ran the author's Python test suite (7 tests, synthetic data) on Linux, Python 3.10.12, at commit 30c6d21 on 24 Nov 2026: 7 passed. The Rust tests were not run.

avoid.why: No source code, only a README, two images and a workflow file with a random name. It asks you to run a PowerShell install script from a web page. It had 340 stars two days after it was created. We did not run it, and you should not either.
